title: Double phase flow under Lavrentiev phenomenon
summary: This paper deals with parabolic equations associated with double phase functionals. It is known that double phase functionals may exhibit the Lavrentiev phenomenon, which indicates an existence of a singular minimizer. Our aim is to investigate the process of the associated double phase flow evolving toward the singular minimizer. For this purpose, we study whether solutions can be approximated by smooth functions.
